english.title: Attempt to cause a male aged 13 or over to engage in a penetrative sexual activity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to cause a

(A)_[boy aged 13]_
(B)_[boy aged 14]_
(C)_[boy aged 15]_
(D)_[man aged 16 or over]_

to engage in sexual activity which would have involved the penetration of

(E)_[his anus]_
(F)_[his mouth with a person's penis]_
(G)_[a person's anus with a part of his body, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE BODY..),]_
(H)_[a person's vagina with a part of his body, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE BODY..),]_
(I)_[a person's anus by him with a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..),]_
(J)_[a person's vagina by him with a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..),]_
(K)_[a person's mouth with his penis]_
(L)_[**(..WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE ACTIVITIES ARE INVOLVED PLEASE SPECIFY..)]_

with intent to do so when he did not consent and you did not reasonably believe that he was consenting
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Provided the victim was under16 an act done by a person in a country or territory outside the United Kingdom which, constituted an offence under the law in force in that country or territory, and would constitute a sexual offence to which this section applies if it had been done in England and Wales or in Northern Ireland, constitutes that sexual offence under the law of that part of the United Kingdom, and provided that person was on 01/09/1997, or who has since become a British citizen or resident in the United Kingdom he/she may have proceedings brought against them in the United Kingdom. (section 72).
(ii) A person guilty of this offence is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act. (Sch 3 paragraph 19).
(iii) Whether a belief is reasonable is to be determined having regard to all the circumstances, including any steps the offender has taken to ascertain whether the victim consented - (section 4(2)).
(iv) IMPORTANT - carefully check an offender's previous convictions. Provisions under sections 224 to 235 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 may mean that s/he is liable to receive a longer sentence if certain conditions apply.
(v) Victim's age should be proved by reference to a Birth Certificate where possible.

other.penalty:
Indictment only: Life imprisonment

See Note (v) above re mandatory life sentence

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
